thread:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: auto-page: PagerDuty P1 fired for PROD - edge-prod LB targets unhealthy (TLS handshake failures). Pager: https://pager.example/INC1769991234
pagerduty: Auto-ack: false. Priority: P1. Initial symptoms: spike in 521/526 TLS errors, client TLS handshake timeouts in eu-west-1 and ap-northeast-1.
alice: Acked. I'm oncall. grabbing logs.—checking LB target health now.
carol: Seeing same in monitoring: target group \"edge-prod-backend\" has 40% unhealthy in eu-west-1. TLS alert spike at 11:02 UTC.
dave: Correlating with cert rotation job kicked at 10:58 UTC — rolling certs to edge nodes; logs show openssl handshake fail: \"sslv3 alert handshake failure\".
alice: Can someone run `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:... --region eu-west-1` and paste output?
carol: pasted output:
```
{ "TargetHealthDescriptions": [ { "Target": { "Id": "i-0abc", "Port": 443 }, "HealthCheckPort": "traffic-port", "TargetHealth": { "State": "unhealthy", "Reason": "TLSHandshakeError" } }, ... ] }
```
bob: PagerDuty -> I'm taking over from alice. alice — share which cert version we rolled and any recent nginx/openssl libs?
alice: cert version v2026-03-15-rot1, shipped via rollout service. No nginx package changes. openssl on nodes still 1.1.1k.
eve-customer-ops: @eve-customer-ops can you estimate impact? Any large customers reporting errors?
eve-customer-ops: Early signs: errors in support triage, mainly API requests to chat endpoints returning 524/blank. Rough estimate ~3% of traffic from EU/APAC hitting edge-prod failing TLS. No major enterprise reports yet.
bob: Ok immediate mitigations: 1) Pause cert rollout in other regions. 2) Drain unhealthy targets from LB and move traffic to healthy pool in us-east-1. 3) If that doesn't stabilize, rollback to previous cert on affected nodes.
dave: I'm pausing cert rollout now: `rollout cancel --id rot1 --regions eu-west-1 ap-northeast-1` — done.
carol: Initiating target drain & weight shift: set route weight eu-west-1 -> us-east-1 at 60% -> 100% over 5min.
alice: Running quick sanity check against a drained node: `openssl s_client -connect i-0abc:443 -servername api.redwood.example` shows `handshake failure` and `no shared cipher`.
bob: That suggests cert chain or cipher mismatch. Can we `curl -v --tls-max 1.2 https://i-0abc/health` from jumpbox?
carol: curl shows `SSL: no alternative certificate subject name matching` — cert SAN doesn't include the internal hostname. Rolling cert generator may have dropped SAN for internal fqdns.
alice: Confirmed: cert metadata missing internal hostnames — regression in rollout template.
bob: Plan: 1) Reissue certs with correct SANs and deploy to affected nodes (longer fix). 2) Short term: switch traffic to instances with previous cert (we have snapshots) and keep rollout paused. 3) PagerDuty escalate to infra lead for cert generator rollback.
pagerduty: Escalation: paging infra-lead @frank and security@ on-call.
frank: oncall infra lead — looking. If cert generator broke template, we should rollback to generator v1.5 which produced correct SANs.
alice: Taking snapshot of healthy nodes then updating ELB target-group to only route to version tagged v2026-03-14.
dave: Weight shift done to us-east-1. Unhealthy count in eu-west-1 dropped to 5% after move. Client errors falling.
eve-customer-ops: Support update: posting banner to status page — \"Partial TLS interruptions in EU/APAC affecting some requests. Working on mitigation.\" :warning:
bob: Noting timeline for postmortem. For now I'll keep PD incident open until full cert rollback verified across all edge nodes. monitoring: keep an eye on TLS handshake error rate.
alice: +1. I'll run the cert generator rollback after frank gives thumbs up.
frank: Rolling back generator to v1.5 now. `deploy generator --version v1.5` — started.
carol: After rollback deploy, I'm seeing new certs issued with SANs including internal hostnames. Rolling into eu-west-1 test pool.
dave: Test nodes now succeed handshake. lb target healthy -> healthy count rising.
pagerduty: PD note: incident acknowledged by bob, escalated to frank, manual mitigation in progress. :construction: 
incidentbot: PD incident INC1769991234 — status: open -> monitoring. auto-close disabled.
bob: I'll hand off to alice at 12:15 UTC for long tail verification. alice, you good to take 2hr watch?
alice: taking handoff. leaving notes in incident playbook. Will keep PD open and update every 15m until metrics stable for 30m.
eve-customer-ops: I've posted to status page and inbound CS queue triaged. No critical customers impacted at scale. Will notify if any enterprise flags.
alice: final note for now: Root cause likely cert generator template regression. Postmortem owners: frank (infra), carol (monitoring), alice (oncall), eve (cs).
incidentbot: closing chat thread — incident still open in PD. If new symptoms, reply here to re-open the thread.
